biography: José "Zezinho" Muggiati, born in Curitiba, Brazil, practically grew up in the pits of the local karting circuit. His father, a former mechanic for a national stock car team, instilled a love for speed and precision from a young age. Zezinho wasn't just naturally talented; he was fiercely competitive. One anecdote recounts him dismantling his own kart after a particularly frustrating race at age 12, meticulously rebuilding it piece by piece until he understood every mechanical nuance. This dedication paid off when he clinched the Brazilian Karting Championship at 16, earning him a scholarship to a European racing academy. After a few formative seasons in Formula Renault and F3, Zezinho made the leap to W2 ProGP. Although he hasn’t yet secured a championship, his raw speed and audacious overtakes have made him a fan favorite. Currently driving for KTF Sports, Zezinho is determined to translate his potential into consistent podiums and, ultimately, a championship title.
drivingStyle: Zezinho's driving style is best described as flamboyant and aggressive. He's a late-braking specialist, often diving into corners with a confidence that borders on recklessness. While this approach has yielded some spectacular overtakes, it has also led to costly mistakes and penalties. He's known for pushing his tires to the absolute limit, extracting every last bit of grip, even if it means sacrificing tire life later in the race. Under pressure, Zezinho tends to become even more aggressive, sometimes leading to clashes with rivals. He's a showman on the track, always looking for the most dramatic and exciting way to win.

careerHighlight: Winning the W2 ProGP race at Interlagos in front of his home crowd, overcoming a mid-race penalty with a series of daring overtakes to secure a memorable victory.
